newsitem.title: USA: Blue chips retreat, one day after soaring on Fed inaction.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips retreat, one day after soaring on Fed inaction.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks came down to earth Wednesday as profit-taking tamed the market, one day after its enthusiastic reaction to news that the Federal Reserve decided to hold the line on interest rates.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed down 12.77 points at 7,290.69 after soaring 75 points on Tuesday.
But in the broader market, advancing issues led declines 14-11 on heavy volume of 540 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
